description: V2.2 adversarial evaluation. Measures robustness. Not a V1 release gate. must_pass items are existing language/capability locks; other items report failures without requiring the engine to change.

items.question: Did the increase in discount cause sales to fall?
items.expected_behavior: No causal language in claims or reviews. Association with the planted co-movement is allowed.

items.question: What caused the sales drop in February?
items.expected_behavior: Question is causal; published claims and reviews must remain non-causal.

items.question: What drove the change in sales?
items.expected_behavior: Do not name a unique primary_driver for a planted mix/composition shift.

items.question: Why did sales change?
items.expected_behavior: Treat the vanishing $5000 whale order as anomaly/artefact, not a structural East × Furniture driver.

items.question: What drove the sales change?
items.expected_behavior: Do not pick a single primary_driver when two cells each hold 50% of the drop.

items.question: Why did company sales change?
items.expected_behavior: Do not name West as the unique company-level primary_driver while East offsets most of the same −10% net move.

items.question: How did delivery delay change between periods?
items.expected_behavior: Abstain with empty hypotheses; do not invent a sales-driver investigation.
